chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Billy Hicks band in Haiti and friendship with a former president's son
summary: Band members, the stint in Haiti, and the friendship with pianist Pierre Bernot, later a UN delegate.

bands.name: Billy Hicks and the Sizzling Six

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who else was in there? Was there other horn?
Big Jumping George(?) -- I forget his last name; it's been a while.

I don't know. I don't remember his last name. And a guitar player by the name of Harry Holt, and Joe Vitas(?) was the tenor player. That was the band. We did a little stint down there, and became very friendly with one of the sons of one of the ex-Presidents, Pierre Bernot(?), who was also a pianist, and later became a delegate to the United Nations from Haiti. We resided at his home in Pichardeau(?), we used to visit regularly.

In those times, that country was beautiful. There's no doubt about it. Since then, Katherine Dunham has...the governments before the Duvaliers, I think, gave over a piece of land to be a landlord over some land there. But anyhow, it was a beautiful country. It is a beautiful country. And it's just too bad that this country doesn't help it. The injustice...
